user.title: Connect ShoppingHeld
user.description: Enter your personal access token. The token is issued by the operator of the ShoppingHeld server. The server address is already filled in.

data_description.url: Only change this if you run your own ShoppingHeld instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new access token
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {title} is invalid or was revoked. Ask for a new one and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the address and your connection.

abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different account.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to the ShoppingHeld shopping list. Without a category ShoppingHeld detects it automatically; "2 milk" as text sets the amount automatically.

set_amount.name: Change amount
set_amount.description: Sets the amount of an item on the ShoppingHeld shopping list.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name of the item (or its internal ID).

add_recipe.name: Recipe to list
add_recipe.description: Reads ingredients from recipe text (also when quantity and name are on separate lines) and adds them with sensible amounts: 1200 ml milk becomes 2 milk, 3 large eggs 3 eggs, 400 g flour 1 flour.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Add nothing, just return the recognised items.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often should Home Assistant fetch the list from ShoppingHeld? A longer interval is easier on the server, but changes made in the app show up a bit later.
